arguments.decision_needed: Tenant reports the LG washing machine provided with the flat has a power failure and says it cannot be fixed (their own web research, not a diagnosis). Alternatively we can send our contractor to inspect and quote.
options: Consent to tenant's own replacement (tenant's item, not on inventory); tell us who pays for removal/fitting and what to do with your machine

arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. We'll update you by 29 July.
